shortDescription: Get the current Caddy configuration for a given path

options.name: caddy_host
options.description: Address of the caddy API endpoint

options.name: path
options.description: Path from which the configuration content will be read. Note that C(config/) is automatically appended. Example: "apps/http/servers/myservice"

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for connections to the caddy API in seconds
